beijing.overview: Beijing rewards a neighbourhood-by-neighbourhood approach. Imperial courtyards occupy enormous blocks; the quieter pleasures are in hutong lanes, lakeside paths and breakfast shops between them. Keep the Great Wall on a separate day and resist crossing the city for every meal.

sights.name: Summer Palace
sights.description: Lakeside paths, painted corridors and palace gardens northwest of the centre. Give this an unhurried half-day; the grounds involve substantial walking.

sights.name: Jingshan Park
sights.description: Climb the central hill for a view over the Forbidden City roofs. A useful short stop after the palace, with steps to the viewpoint.

sights.name: Beihai Park
sights.description: A lake, white stupa and garden pavilions west of Jingshan. Choose it for a gentler park afternoon rather than another museum.

sights.name: Shichahai hutongs
sights.description: Explore the lanes behind the lakes, then pause for tea. These remain residential streets: keep doorways clear and ask before photographing people.

sights.name: 798 Art District
sights.description: Former industrial buildings now house galleries and design shops. Browse a few exhibitions rather than expecting one single-ticket attraction.

foods.name: Peking duck
foods.description: Order roast duck with pancakes, scallions and sauce; a shared meal makes more sense than a quick solo snack.

foods.name: Zhajiangmian
foods.description: Wheat noodles with savoury bean sauce and vegetable toppings. A practical lunch between sights; meat is common in the sauce.

foods.name: Beijing breakfast
foods.description: Try sesame flatbreads or jianbing from a busy breakfast shop. Huguosi is a useful area to explore traditional snacks.

areas.name: Wangfujing / Dongsi
areas.description: Convenient for a first visit and eastern old-city sights; choose a hotel near a metro entrance rather than judging only distance on a map.

areas.name: Gulou / Shichahai
areas.description: Atmospheric lanes and evening walks, but some courtyard stays have difficult vehicle access and less soundproofing.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Check whether your flight uses Capital or Daxing airport. Railway departures may use Beijing South, West, Chaoyang or another station: save the exact Chinese station name.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The metro is useful for long hops; explore one hutong district on foot. Large roads and security queues make short map distances misleading.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Mutianyu, Badaling and the Ming Tombs are outside central Beijing. Choose one main excursion and confirm the return transfer before departure.

routes.name: Old-city day
routes.description: Build around a confirmed Forbidden City reservation, followed by Jingshan. Leave the late afternoon free for nearby lanes rather than adding the Summer Palace.

routes.name: Extra days
routes.description: Give the Temple of Heaven and a neighbourhood meal one day; the Summer Palace another half-day; reserve a separate day for your chosen Great Wall section.

beijing.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

shanghai.overview: Shanghai is best read at street level before you look down from a tower. Move between the riverfront, tree-lined former concession streets and small local eating places. Pudong and the old city show very different faces; neither needs to be squeezed into a single skyline photograph.

sights.name: Yu Garden
sights.description: A classical garden in the old city, surrounded by a busy bazaar. Separate time inside the garden from shopping and snacks outside.

sights.name: Shanghai Tower
sights.description: An elevated view over Pudong and the Huangpu River. Choose a clear day; poor visibility can make a tower visit less rewarding.

sights.name: Jade Buddha Temple
sights.description: An active Buddhist temple with sculptural and architectural interest. Keep voices low and follow photography instructions inside halls.

sights.name: Suzhou Creek
sights.description: A riverside walk linking industrial heritage and newer cultural spaces. Pick a short section near your accommodation rather than attempting the whole waterfront.

sights.name: Zhujiajiao
sights.description: A water-town day trip with canals, bridges and narrow lanes. Leave time for the onward transfer from the metro and a relaxed return.

foods.name: Xiaolongbao
foods.description: Small steamed buns holding hot soup, usually pork-based. Let them cool and take a small bite before drinking the broth.

foods.name: Shengjianbao
foods.description: Pan-fried buns with crisp bases and juicy fillings. A filling breakfast or inexpensive lunch rather than a delicate dessert.

foods.name: Benbang dishes
foods.description: Shanghai home-style cooking often uses soy sauce and a little sweetness. Try red-braised pork with vegetables and rice as a shared meal.

areas.name: People's Square / Jing'an
areas.description: Central metro connections and a wide hotel range. Check whether the room faces a busy road.

areas.name: Xuhui / former concession streets
areas.description: Good for cafes and walking between meals; allow extra travel time for Pudong airport and attractions across the river.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Pudong and Hongqiao are different airports. Hongqiao railway station connects with the airport complex, but terminal transfers still take time.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use the metro for cross-city travel and walk within individual neighbourhoods. A ferry can add a river-level perspective when its route suits your plans.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Zhujiajiao needs its own half-day or longer. Suzhou and Hangzhou work better as deliberately planned rail excursions than last-minute additions.

routes.name: Two contrasting days
routes.description: Walk the Bund and old city on one day. On another, combine the former concession streets with a museum or gallery chosen for your interests.

routes.name: An extra day
routes.description: Choose either a Pudong skyline visit in clear weather or a slower Zhujiajiao excursion. Do not plan both around a tightly timed airport departure.

shanghai.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

guilin.overview: Think of this region as several bases rather than one city. Guilin has urban lakes and caves; Yangshuo has countryside lanes; Xingping has river scenery; Longji is a separate mountain excursion. Where you sleep changes how much of each day you spend in a vehicle.

sights.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
sights.description: The city landmark at the meeting of river and karst scenery. Pair it with a waterfront stroll rather than expecting a remote wilderness experience.

sights.name: Reed Flute Cave
sights.description: An illuminated limestone cave near Guilin. A useful weather alternative, with artificial lighting rather than an untouched cave expedition.

sights.name: Two Rivers and Four Lakes
sights.description: Lakeside paths and bridges make an easy urban walk. The evening atmosphere differs from the daytime gardens; a cruise is optional.

sights.name: Longji Rice Terraces
sights.description: A full-day trip or overnight stay from Guilin. Choose a village base and walking route before arranging transport; terraces change with the agricultural season.

sights.name: Daxu Ancient Town
sights.description: Old trading streets beside the Li River outside the centre. Combine a gentle lane walk with riverside time rather than treating it as a major hiking day.

foods.name: Guilin rice noodles
foods.description: A breakfast staple with rice noodles, savoury toppings and pickles. Ask about meat and chilli before mixing everything together.

foods.name: Yangshuo beer fish
foods.description: Fish cooked in a beer-based sauce, commonly shared. Confirm fish size and the total price before ordering.

foods.name: Oil tea
foods.description: A savoury tea-based preparation associated with local communities. Try it alongside snacks; it is quite different from a pot of plain tea.

areas.name: Central Guilin lakes
areas.description: Practical for an arrival night, urban sightseeing and onward travel; it does not put you in the Yangshuo countryside.

areas.name: Yangshuo / Yulong River
areas.description: Town offers more dining choices; countryside stays offer quieter scenery but require planned transfers after dinner.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Check whether your ticket says Guilin, Guilin North or Guilin West. Yangshuo railway station is near Xingping, not beside Yangshuo town.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use walking for the central lakes and vehicles for separated sights. Around Yangshuo, choose short cycling routes suited to your experience and the road conditions.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Longji and Yangshuo lie in different directions from Guilin. River activities depend on weather and water conditions; keep an alternative land-based day.

routes.name: A regional introduction
routes.description: Use an arrival afternoon for Guilin lakes. Move toward Yangshuo for a countryside day and choose one Li River experience rather than repeating similar cruises.

routes.name: With more time
routes.description: Add Xingping at an unhurried pace, or spend a night at Longji. Avoid adding the terraces between two tightly scheduled transport connections.

guilin.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

chengdu.overview: Chengdu is a city of pauses: tea under trees, a bowl of noodles, then a museum or temple. Its famous excursions spread in several directions, so a comfortable visit balances neighbourhood time with one carefully chosen day trip. The food deserves its own place in the schedule.

sights.name: Wuhou Shrine
sights.description: Courtyards and memorial halls associated with the Three Kingdoms. Pair the visit with nearby Jinli, while keeping time for the historical exhibits.

sights.name: Jinli Street
sights.description: A lively, commercial lane of snacks and traditional-style architecture. Visit for atmosphere; compare prices before buying souvenirs.

sights.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage
sights.description: Gardens and buildings commemorating the Tang poet. A quieter cultural afternoon, especially for visitors who prefer parks to shopping streets.

sights.name: Sanxingdui Museum
sights.description: A full-day trip to Guanghan for striking ancient bronzes and archaeological displays. Plan the museum reservation and onward transfer together.

sights.name: Dujiangyan
sights.description: A full-day trip to the historic irrigation landscape. Bridges and waterworks involve walking; combining it with Qingcheng Mountain makes a much longer day.

foods.name: Mapo tofu
foods.description: Silky tofu in a chilli-and-peppercorn sauce, often containing minced meat. Ask specifically if you need a meat-free version.

foods.name: Dandan noodles
foods.description: A small noodle dish with a punchy sauce. Useful for tasting alongside other snacks rather than ordering every dish as a full meal.

foods.name: Sichuan hotpot
foods.description: A social meal with ingredients cooked at the table. A divided broth can help a mixed group, but confirm each broth's ingredients.

areas.name: Tianfu Square / Chunxi Road
areas.description: Convenient for metro journeys and a broad hotel choice; larger shopping streets can remain busy late.

areas.name: Wenshu / Qingyang
areas.description: Good for temple visits and neighbourhood meals. Pick a stay near transport if you plan several excursions.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Tianfu and Shuangliu airports are separate. Check the terminal and allow ample time for Tianfu transfers; Chengdu East is a major high-speed rail hub.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The metro works well between districts. Plan a short taxi or walking connection for places that are not beside a station.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The panda base, Sanxingdui, Dujiangyan and Leshan are different outings. Reserve one major outlying attraction per day.

routes.name: City and pandas
routes.description: Put the panda visit early in a day, then keep the afternoon flexible. Use a separate city day for Wenshu, People's Park and a leisurely Sichuan meal.

routes.name: Choose an excursion
routes.description: Add Sanxingdui for archaeology or Dujiangyan for landscape and engineering. Retain an evening in Chengdu instead of stacking distant stops.

chengdu.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

xian.overview: Xi’an mixes monumental history with lively everyday streets. The walled centre is a useful walking base, but the Terracotta Army and several major museums lie well beyond it. Balance one large archaeological visit with time for noodles, calligraphy streets and the city wall.

sights.name: Shaanxi History Museum
sights.description: An introduction to the region's dynasties through archaeological collections. Build your day around a confirmed reservation and the correct museum location.

sights.name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
sights.description: A Buddhist landmark south of the old city. Explore the surrounding squares at a different pace from the crowded evening pedestrian streets.

sights.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda and Xi'an Museum
sights.description: A quieter pairing of historic grounds and museum collections. Check which areas are accessible before planning a pagoda climb.

sights.name: Bell and Drum Towers
sights.description: Landmarks in the old-city street grid. Seeing the exteriors and surrounding streets may suit a short visit better than entering both.

sights.name: Huaqing Palace
sights.description: An excursion in the Lintong area with imperial associations and landscaped grounds. Treat this as additional time near the Terracotta Army, not a quick city-centre stop.

foods.name: Roujiamo
foods.description: Bread filled with chopped meat; pork and beef versions differ. Check the filling rather than assuming every stall serves the same recipe.

foods.name: Yangrou paomo
foods.description: Crumbled flatbread in mutton broth. A substantial meal, especially welcome on a cool day.

foods.name: Liangpi
foods.description: Cool noodles dressed with vinegar, chilli and other seasonings. Often paired with roujiamo for a simple lunch.

areas.name: South Gate / inside the wall
areas.description: Useful for evening walks and old-city meals. Check walking distance to a metro entrance.

areas.name: Xiaozhai / pagoda district
areas.description: Handy for southern museums and newer hotels, but less atmospheric if most evenings will be spent in the old city.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Xi’an Xianyang airport is outside the city. Xi’an North and the central Xi’an railway station are different; match the station to your ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The metro links major districts. Walk within the walled centre; wall access points and stairways determine where a walking or cycling visit starts.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The Terracotta Army requires an out-of-town transfer. Huashan should be a separate mountain day with weather and return travel considered.

routes.name: Two history days
routes.description: Use one day for the Terracotta Army. Spend another around the wall, Great Mosque area and a relaxed noodle meal.

routes.name: Extend the stay
routes.description: Choose one major museum and the pagoda district on an extra day. Put Huashan on a separate date instead of adding it after a museum.

xian.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

hangzhou.overview: Hangzhou becomes more rewarding as you move away from a checklist of lake viewpoints. Allow time for western shore walks, a tea village and a temple, then explore the canal or old commercial streets. Hills, heat and weekend crowds affect the pace more than distances suggest.

sights.name: Hefang Street
sights.description: A busy old-style shopping street for snacks and small souvenirs. Use nearby lanes to break up the crowds and compare tea prices carefully.

sights.name: Grand Canal and Gongchen Bridge
sights.description: Canal-side walking and historic commercial neighbourhoods north of the lake. A different story of Hangzhou from its famous scenery.

sights.name: Xixi Wetland
sights.description: Waterways, vegetation and slower walking routes west of the centre. Reserve a half-day and check which walking or boat route your ticket covers.

sights.name: Leifeng Pagoda
sights.description: A prominent viewpoint on the south side of West Lake. Choose it for the perspective over the lake rather than as another obligatory tower.

sights.name: China National Tea Museum
sights.description: Tea culture and growing traditions near the western hills. Check the branch address and combine it with one nearby tea-growing area.

foods.name: Dongpo pork
foods.description: Rich braised pork, usually shared with rice and vegetables. Order a small portion first if travelling as a couple.

foods.name: Longjing shrimp
foods.description: Shrimp associated with the city's famous green tea. A gentler-flavoured alternative to heavily seasoned dishes.

foods.name: Osmanthus lotus root
foods.description: Lotus root stuffed with glutinous rice and served sweet. A distinctive local dish to share rather than a savoury side.

areas.name: East side of West Lake
areas.description: Convenient for first visits, dining and city transport, but usually busier than the western shore.

areas.name: West Lake hills / tea villages
areas.description: Atmospheric for a slow stay; dining choice and evening transport can be more limited.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Hangzhou East, Hangzhou station and Hangzhou West serve different rail journeys. Xiaoshan airport is another substantial transfer from the lake.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk selected lake sections rather than the whole perimeter. Use the metro for city districts and buses or taxis for hill-side destinations.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Tea villages, Lingyin and Xixi are spread out. Keep a flexible hill day for weather and avoid linking all three by repeated cross-city transfers.

routes.name: Lake and hills
routes.description: Spend one day around a chosen West Lake shore and old streets. Give Lingyin and a nearby tea stop another day, allowing for queues and hill roads.

routes.name: A quieter extension
routes.description: Explore the Grand Canal or Xixi on an extra day. Pick one landscape and spend time there instead of collecting multiple entrances.

hangzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

chongqing.overview: Chongqing is three-dimensional: a street on the map may sit far above the road beside it. Split your visit by peninsula and riverbank, and allow time for lifts, steps and viewpoints. Hotpot and the night riverfront are part of the experience, not rewards squeezed in after sightseeing.

sights.name: Three Gorges Museum
sights.description: A useful introduction to the region and the Yangtze. Pair it with the People's Auditorium exterior nearby.

sights.name: Ciqikou
sights.description: A historic riverside district with busy souvenir and snack streets. Seek the quieter side lanes, but expect a commercial visitor area.

sights.name: Liziba viewpoint
sights.description: Watch a train pass through a building from the viewing area. A short photo stop rather than a full neighbourhood itinerary.

sights.name: Eling Park
sights.description: Hilltop greenery and city views. Allow for slopes and choose clear weather if the panorama is your main reason for visiting.

sights.name: Wulong karst landscapes
sights.description: A full-day trip or overnight excursion outside the urban core. Scenic-area transfers and walking take time; do not combine it with Dazu.

foods.name: Chongqing hotpot
foods.description: A strongly flavoured communal meal, often with beef-fat broth. Confirm broth and ingredients if your group has dietary restrictions.

foods.name: Xiaomian
foods.description: Small bowls of noodles with chilli and peppercorn seasoning. Ask for a gentler version before the sauce is added.

foods.name: Suanlafen
foods.description: Sour-and-spicy noodles, commonly made from sweet-potato starch. Good for a casual snack stop; toppings can include meat.

areas.name: Jiefangbei
areas.description: A convenient first-time base for central sights and food, though traffic and busy streets can slow taxi pickups.

areas.name: Guanyinqiao
areas.description: A lively dining and shopping district across the river. Good metro access matters more than straight-line distance to attractions.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Jiangbei airport, Chongqing North, West and other railway stations are widely separated. Save the exact station and entrance shown on your ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use rail transit between districts, then walk shorter routes. A map route may contain many stairs; ask hotels about step-free arrival.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Dazu and Wulong are separate full-day excursions. For a river cruise, confirm the actual boarding pier rather than navigating to a general waterfront.

routes.name: Urban contrasts
routes.description: Pair the museum and auditorium with Eling or Liziba. Save a separate afternoon and evening for Jiefangbei, the lanes and riverfront lights.

routes.name: Beyond the city
routes.description: Choose Dazu for carvings or Wulong for karst scenery. Leave a buffer night before an important onward connection.

chongqing.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

suzhou.overview: Suzhou is more than a quick garden stop from Shanghai. Its best days move slowly between a garden, a canal lane and a noodle shop. Gardens can blur together if you visit too many at once; choose contrasting styles and keep a water-town excursion separate.

sights.name: Lingering Garden
sights.description: A classical garden of framed views, rocks and connected courtyards. An alternative to adding several gardens near the museum in one morning.

sights.name: Master of the Nets Garden
sights.description: A compact garden that rewards close attention to proportions and reflections. A good choice when you want an intimate visit.

sights.name: Tiger Hill
sights.description: A hilltop pagoda and landscaped historic grounds northwest of the old centre. Expect steps and allow a half-day with travel.

sights.name: Shantang Street
sights.description: Canal-side buildings and busy evening lanes. Walk beyond the first crowded stretch to find a less hurried rhythm.

sights.name: Tongli
sights.description: A water-town day trip with canals, bridges and garden courtyards. Leave time for the transfer between rail transit and the old town.

foods.name: Suzhou-style noodles
foods.description: Fine noodles in clear or darker broth with separate toppings. Try a bowl early in the day when traditional noodle shops are active.

foods.name: Squirrel-shaped mandarin fish
foods.description: A fried whole fish with a sweet-sour sauce, usually best shared by several people.

foods.name: Seasonal rice cakes
foods.description: Local pastries and glutinous-rice sweets change through the year. Buy small portions to compare textures and sweetness.

areas.name: Guanqian / Pingjiang area
areas.description: Useful for old-city walks, gardens and food. Some lane-side hotels require a final walk with luggage.

areas.name: Jinji Lake
areas.description: More contemporary hotels and waterfront space; expect metro journeys back to the historic centre.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Suzhou station is convenient for the historic city; Suzhou North is a separate high-speed station. Nearby Shanghai airports require an additional transfer.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Combine the metro with walking within the old town. Garden entrances can be close on a map but separated by busy streets and queues.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Tongli and Zhouzhuang are separate water towns. Choose one and avoid trying to pair it with a full old-city garden day.

routes.name: Gardens without rushing
routes.description: Visit the Humble Administrator's Garden and nearby museum if reservations align, then walk Pingjiang Road. Save another garden for the next day.

routes.name: A different perspective
routes.description: Combine Tiger Hill and Shantang, or dedicate an extra day to Tongli. Keep time for a canal-side meal.

suzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

zhangjiajie.overview: Zhangjiajie is a collection of scenic areas, not a single mountain entrance. Wulingyuan is the useful base for the sandstone peaks; the urban centre serves Tianmen Mountain. Plan around your accommodation and entrance, and allow spare time when fog obscures the views.

sights.name: Yuanjiajie
sights.description: A plateau of sandstone-pillar viewpoints inside the forest park. Combine it with nearby park transport, not an unrelated city attraction.

sights.name: Golden Whip Stream
sights.description: A valley walk beneath tall rock formations. A useful lower-level contrast to the high viewpoints, with walking distance tailored to your energy.

sights.name: Huangshi Village
sights.description: A forest-park plateau with panoramic paths. Choose it as an alternative park sector rather than attempting every summit area in a day.

sights.name: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon
sights.description: A separate day trip from the forest park, with canyon walking and the famous glass bridge. Check the exact ticket and activity bundle.

sights.name: Baofeng Lake
sights.description: A lake excursion near Wulingyuan with boat-based sightseeing. An option for a gentler half-day, subject to local operations and weather.

foods.name: Sanxiaguo
foods.description: A shared hotpot-style local dish whose meat and offal combination varies. Ask what is included before ordering.

foods.name: Smoked pork
foods.description: Preserved pork commonly cooked with vegetables. Rich and salty, so pair a small plate with rice and greens.

foods.name: Sour vegetables
foods.description: Pickled vegetables appear in many local dishes. Request chilli separately where possible rather than assuming sour means mild.

areas.name: Wulingyuan entrance area
areas.description: Practical for repeat forest-park days and early starts. Confirm the exact entrance your accommodation serves.

areas.name: Zhangjiajie city centre
areas.description: Better for Tianmen Mountain and urban transport connections; it adds a road transfer to forest-park visits.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Zhangjiajie West railway station and Hehua airport are not at the forest-park gate. Arrange the final transfer to your chosen base.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Inside the park, walking connects with managed buses and other transport. Cableways and lifts save ascent but do not remove all steps.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Tianmen Mountain and the Grand Canyon have separate entry systems. Do not treat them as add-ons inside the Wulingyuan park ticket.

routes.name: A mountain-focused stay
routes.description: Use two days for complementary forest-park sectors, keeping one lower valley walk in the mix. Choose the daily order after seeing the forecast.

routes.name: A separate mountain day
routes.description: Move or transfer to the city for Tianmen Mountain. Add the Grand Canyon only with another full day, not between departure connections.

zhangjiajie.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

huangshan.overview: Huangshan can mean the city, the mountain or the wider region of Huizhou villages. These are different bases. Decide whether your priority is summit scenery or village architecture, then build transport around that choice; a mountain hotel is a logistical decision as much as a scenic one.

sights.name: Xidi
sights.description: A full-day village excursion when paired carefully with nearby stops. Stone lanes and ancestral buildings offer a different atmosphere from the mountain.

sights.name: Chengkan
sights.description: An old Huizhou village with lanes, waterways and traditional buildings. Allow time to explore on foot rather than stopping only for a photograph.

sights.name: Tangmo
sights.description: A village excursion for waterside architecture and a slower walk. Check the transfer distance from your chosen base before adding another village.

sights.name: Huizhou Ancient City
sights.description: Historic streets and monuments in Shexian. An alternative to the mountain for travellers interested in architecture and regional history.

sights.name: Xin'an River waterfront
sights.description: An easy walk in the Tunxi area. Useful on an arrival evening when you do not have time for a mountain transfer.

foods.name: Fermented mandarin fish
foods.description: A strongly aromatic regional speciality, cooked before serving. Try it as a shared dish if your group enjoys bold flavours.

foods.name: Hairy tofu
foods.description: Fermented tofu with a distinctive surface, usually cooked at the stall or restaurant. Ask how it will be prepared.

foods.name: Huangshan sesame pastries
foods.description: Small baked pastries, often with savoury fillings. Handy for a travel day; check whether the filling contains pork.

areas.name: Tunxi
areas.description: Useful for arrival, old streets and regional transport. It is not at the mountain gate.

areas.name: Tangkou / mountain hotels
areas.description: Tangkou serves the southern mountain approach. A summit stay can reduce backtracking but involves carrying essentials up the mountain.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Huangshan North station and Tunxi airport serve the wider region. Confirm whether your onward transfer ends in Tunxi, Tangkou or a village.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The mountain uses managed transfers, cableways and walking paths. Expect stairs even when taking a cableway; choose a route suited to the group.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Group village visits geographically. Do not add Hongcun or Xidi after a demanding summit walk unless you have deliberately allowed another night.

routes.name: Mountains first
routes.description: Transfer to the mountain base, then give the mountain a full day or an overnight stay. Keep the route flexible for visibility and closures.

routes.name: Village extension
routes.description: Spend a separate day in Hongcun or Xidi and return to Tunxi for the old street. Avoid changing hotels every night if travelling with heavy luggage.

huangshan.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

dali.overview: Dali combines a compact old town with a very large lake and mountain backdrop. The most satisfying visit chooses a few villages and short lakeside sections instead of attempting a hurried circuit. Bai architecture, food and craft traditions deserve as much time as the scenery.

sights.name: Three Pagodas
sights.description: A landmark complex north of the old town. Give the extensive grounds time rather than treating it only as a roadside photograph.

sights.name: Cangshan
sights.description: A mountain outing with cableways and walking routes. Choose your route for weather and fitness; high areas can feel much colder than town.

sights.name: Zhoucheng
sights.description: A village known for Bai tie-dye traditions. Look for a workshop explaining the process and clarify charges before joining an activity.

sights.name: Shuanglang
sights.description: A lakeside settlement on Erhai's eastern side with cafes and viewpoints. Plan the return transfer instead of assuming it is close to Dali Old Town.

sights.name: Weishan
sights.description: A full-day trip south of Dali for historic streets and local food. Best treated as its own excursion, not a stop on a lake circuit.

foods.name: Rushan
foods.description: A local dairy snack served in different ways, including grilled or fried. Check toppings if you prefer savoury to sweet.

foods.name: Ersi noodles
foods.description: Rice-based strands served in soup or stir-fried. A useful breakfast or quick lunch with locally varying toppings.

foods.name: Bai-style fish casserole
foods.description: A shared fish dish with vegetables and other ingredients. Confirm the recipe and price before ordering.

areas.name: Dali Old Town
areas.description: Convenient for meals and onward excursions; choose side streets if you want quieter nights.

areas.name: Erhai villages
areas.description: Good for a slow lakeside stay, but attractions across the lake require transfers and evening dining can be limited.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Dali railway station is in the modern Xiaguan area, away from the old town. The airport also requires a separate transfer to your accommodation.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Explore the old town on foot and choose short lake-path walks or rides. Check where bikes are permitted rather than assuming a full lakeside circuit is straightforward.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Cangshan, eastern Erhai and Weishan are different outings. Shaxi is better considered as an onward stop or overnight excursion.

routes.name: Old town and lake
routes.description: Spend one day in the old town and Three Pagodas area, then another around Xizhou and a nearby lakeside section.

routes.name: With a third day
routes.description: Choose a suitable Cangshan route or Weishan's streets and food. Leave enough time to reach the railway station in Xiaguan.

dali.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

lijiang.overview: Lijiang works best when you distinguish the busy old-town core from quieter villages and mountain excursions. Canal lanes can be atmospheric early in the day, while Baisha and the foothills offer a different pace. Keep a flexible mountain day rather than scheduling every hour.

sights.name: Black Dragon Pool
sights.description: A landscaped park with mountain views when skies are clear. Pair it with a gentle old-town day rather than relying on a guaranteed reflection photograph.

sights.name: Shuhe Ancient Town
sights.description: A second historic settlement with lanes, streams and shops. Spend time beyond the busiest commercial streets.

sights.name: Mu's Residence
sights.description: Courtyards associated with Lijiang's former ruling family. A useful introduction to local history within the old-town area.

sights.name: Yuhu Village
sights.description: A stone-built village near the mountain foothills. Arrange return transport and respect working homes while walking through the lanes.

sights.name: Tiger Leaping Gorge
sights.description: A separate full-day excursion for viewpoints, or a longer stay for trekking. The viewing area and multi-day high trail are very different trips.

foods.name: Naxi baba
foods.description: A local flatbread with sweet or savoury versions. Ask which filling is being served before buying.

foods.name: Chickpea jelly
foods.description: A cool or cooked chickpea-starch dish with seasoning. Chilli and other toppings vary from shop to shop.

foods.name: Preserved pork-rib hotpot
foods.description: A shared pot featuring cured ribs and vegetables. A substantial evening meal, with a naturally salty broth.

areas.name: Dayan Old Town edge
areas.description: Atmosphere with easier luggage access than the deepest lanes. Check noise from nearby bars.

areas.name: Shuhe / Baisha
areas.description: A quieter base for village time, with extra transfers for the city and station.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Lijiang railway station and Sanyi airport are outside the old-town lanes. Confirm the nearest vehicle drop-off point to your hotel.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk within each historic settlement, then use vehicles between them. Stone paving and steps make wheeled luggage awkward.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and Tiger Leaping Gorge need separate days. Confirm route difficulty and current access before committing to a mountain excursion.

routes.name: Town and villages
routes.description: Start with Dayan and Black Dragon Pool. Spend another day in Baisha or Shuhe with time for a meal and local crafts.

routes.name: Mountain extension
routes.description: Reserve a separate weather-dependent day for the snow mountain. Add the gorge only with enough time for the return journey or an overnight stay.

lijiang.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

kunming.overview: Kunming is worth a pause between Yunnan destinations. Lake walks, temples, markets and a strong provincial museum offer an introduction to the region without constant hotel changes. The Stone Forest lies outside the city, so keep it separate from a day of urban exploring.

sights.name: Yuantong Temple
sights.description: An active Buddhist temple near central Kunming. Combine it with Green Lake for a calm walking day.

sights.name: Western Hills
sights.description: A hill-and-temple excursion overlooking Dianchi. Allow time for transport, stairs and weather-dependent views.

sights.name: Dianchi lakeshore
sights.description: A broad lake setting for a gentle walk. Choose a specific shore or park entrance rather than navigating simply to the lake.

sights.name: Dounan Flower Market
sights.description: A working flower-trading area with a different rhythm from a museum. Check visiting arrangements and give traders space.

sights.name: Golden Temple
sights.description: A historic temple complex in wooded grounds northeast of the centre. A separate half-day outing if you enjoy architecture and parks.

foods.name: Crossing-the-bridge noodles
foods.description: Rice noodles served with broth and separate ingredients. Follow the restaurant's instructions for adding and cooking the ingredients.

foods.name: Small-pot rice noodles
foods.description: A comforting single-bowl meal with local toppings. Check the broth and meat content if you have dietary needs.

foods.name: Flower cakes
foods.description: Pastries often filled with rose petals. Buy a small fresh batch and check storage instructions before taking them onward.

areas.name: Green Lake / city centre
areas.description: Good for walking, food and a first short stay. A nearby metro stop makes onward travel easier.

areas.name: Kunming South station area
areas.description: Useful for an early train, but distant from many central sights; choose it for logistics rather than atmosphere.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Changshui airport, Kunming station and Kunming South are separate hubs. Check the departure station before choosing an overnight stop.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The metro helps with longer urban journeys. Group Green Lake and Yuantong together, and give southern museum or lake visits their own time.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The Stone Forest requires an onward transfer beyond the city. Jiuxiang is another excursion, not an effortless add-on after a full sightseeing day.

routes.name: A city pause
routes.description: Combine Green Lake and Yuantong, with a noodle lunch. On another day choose the provincial museum or the Western Hills and lake area.

routes.name: A landscape day
routes.description: Give the Stone Forest its own day and keep the return evening easy before onward travel to Dali or Lijiang.

kunming.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

guiyang.overview: Guiyang is a useful introduction to Guizhou, with riverside landmarks, forested hills and a food culture built around sour and spicy flavours. The province is much larger than its capital: waterfalls and village stays need their own travel days rather than being presented as city attractions.

sights.name: Guizhou Provincial Museum
sights.description: A starting point for the province's history and cultural traditions. Pair it with nearby northern-city plans, not a rushed transfer to Qingyan.

sights.name: Tianhetan
sights.description: A scenic excursion southwest of the centre with water and cave landscapes. Allow a half-day or longer and check the available routes.

sights.name: Huaxi Park
sights.description: A riverside park in the southern district. A gentler outdoor visit that can fit a day based around Huaxi.

sights.name: Wenchang Pavilion
sights.description: A historic city landmark suited to a shorter central walk. Combine it with nearby streets rather than travelling across town only for this stop.

sights.name: Huangguoshu Waterfall
sights.description: A separate full-day trip or overnight excursion near Anshun. Transfers and scenic-area walking make it unsuitable as a quick Guiyang city stop.

foods.name: Sour-soup fish
foods.description: A shared fish dish with a sour broth associated with Guizhou's wider food traditions. Confirm fish size and price first.

foods.name: Siwawa
foods.description: Small wrappers filled with vegetable strips and dipping sauce. Ask about the sauce if avoiding meat or seafood ingredients.

foods.name: Changwang noodles
foods.description: A strongly flavoured noodle dish commonly containing intestines and blood curd. Check the toppings before ordering.

areas.name: Jiaxiu / central Nanming
areas.description: Useful for evening walks and local food. Choose a metro connection for longer journeys.

areas.name: Guanshanhu / Guiyang North
areas.description: Newer hotels and convenient rail logistics, with more travel to the historic central areas.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Longdongbao airport and Guiyang North or East railway stations serve different journeys. Confirm the final city transfer before booking a tight connection.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use the metro between districts and walking within each area. Hills and larger roads can make a short map distance less convenient than expected.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Qingyan lies to the south; Huangguoshu and distant village destinations require separate planning. Do not treat all of Guizhou as a day-trip radius.

routes.name: Two city days
routes.description: Pair Qianling Park with central food streets and an evening near Jiaxiu. Give Qingyan a separate outing, optionally with a nearby Huaxi stop.

routes.name: Extend into Guizhou
routes.description: Choose Huangguoshu or an overnight village journey as the next leg. Keep time in the schedule for regional transfers.

guiyang.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

xiamen.overview: Xiamen lends itself to days shaped by the coast: a temple, a small district of shops and cafes, then a waterfront walk. Gulangyu is a separate island visit with ferry logistics. The Fujian tulou are much farther inland and deserve their own excursion.

sights.name: Hulishan Fortress
sights.description: A coastal fort with historic artillery. Pair it with a nearby seafront walk instead of another cross-island journey.

sights.name: Huandao Road coast
sights.description: Choose a manageable section of shoreline for walking or cycling. The whole coastal road is much longer than a casual stroll.

sights.name: Zhongshan Road
sights.description: Covered shopping streets and snack stops near the old centre. Explore side streets and compare prices before buying food gifts.

sights.name: Jimei School Village
sights.description: Architecture and waterfront spaces on the mainland side of Xiamen. Give the cross-water journey and walking time a half-day.

sights.name: Fujian tulou
sights.description: A full-day trip or overnight excursion to inland earthen-building clusters. Choose one cluster and a realistic transfer plan; they are not in Xiamen city.

foods.name: Shacha noodles
foods.description: Noodles in a rich sauce-based broth with selectable toppings. Peanut and seafood ingredients may be present.

foods.name: Oyster omelette
foods.description: Small oysters cooked with egg and starch. Best ordered freshly cooked and shared alongside other dishes.

foods.name: Peanut soup
foods.description: A sweet peanut dessert, often eaten warm. A gentle finish to a snack walk around the older shopping streets.

areas.name: Zhongshan Road / old centre
areas.description: Good for food and waterfront walks; confirm the departure terminal for any Gulangyu ferry.

areas.name: Huandao Road coast
areas.description: Quieter seaside stays with more space, but extra journeys for city restaurants and rail connections.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Xiamen and Xiamen North railway stations are different: North is on the mainland. Check the airport and terminal named on your actual flight booking.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Metro and buses connect districts; walk within coastal neighbourhoods. Gulangyu ferry terminal and passenger arrangements need checking before setting out.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Tulou clusters require substantial road travel. Do not combine them with Gulangyu on a single day.

routes.name: Coast and island
routes.description: Give Gulangyu a full, unhurried day. Use another for South Putuo, Shapowei and a selected coastal walk.

routes.name: An extra day
routes.description: Choose Jimei for architecture or a separately arranged tulou excursion. Leave a buffer before an onward flight.

xiamen.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

guangzhou.overview: Guangzhou is a food city with layers of river trade, clan architecture and modern development. Plan meals as part of the route: morning tea can be the main event. The western old-city districts and the eastern skyline work best on different days.

sights.name: Canton Tower
sights.description: A modern riverfront landmark with optional elevated views. A clear evening is more useful than squeezing it into a cloudy afternoon.

sights.name: Yuexiu Park
sights.description: A large urban park with historic landmarks and shaded paths. Choose a short loop if travelling in hot weather.

sights.name: Museum of the Nanyue King
sights.description: Archaeological collections that explain an older chapter of the city. Confirm the museum branch associated with the exhibits you want.

sights.name: Sacred Heart Cathedral
sights.description: A distinctive stone cathedral in the older city. Respect worship times and any visitor restrictions.

sights.name: Baiyun Mountain
sights.description: A hill-and-park outing north of the centre. Allow a half-day or longer and select a route that suits the group's walking ability.

foods.name: Dim sum
foods.description: Small steamed and baked dishes served with tea. Order gradually so the table does not fill with more food than you need.

foods.name: Wonton noodles
foods.description: Fine noodles and filled dumplings in broth, often with pork and shrimp. A practical light meal between walks.

foods.name: Cantonese roast meats
foods.description: Roast goose, duck and char siu are common options. A rice plate lets a solo traveller try a small portion.

areas.name: Liwan / old western centre
areas.description: Good for traditional food and historic streets. Check hotel condition and walking distance to the metro.

areas.name: Tianhe / Zhujiang New Town
areas.description: Modern hotels and transport links, with more commuting to the older neighbourhoods.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Baiyun airport and Guangzhou South railway station sit outside the old centre. Check the exact station: Guangzhou, East and South are not interchangeable.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Metro travel is useful between the old centre and newer eastern districts. Walk shorter shaded sections in warm weather.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Foshan is a separate city visit even when rail links make it accessible. Allow time at both ends of any intercity journey.

routes.name: Old and new
routes.description: Combine Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, Liwan and Shamian on an old-city day. Explore the modern riverfront on a separate afternoon and evening.

routes.name: Slow the pace
routes.description: Reserve a morning for tea, then choose a museum or Baiyun Mountain rather than adding multiple distant sights.

guangzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

shenzhen.overview: Shenzhen is most interesting as a lived-in modern city: design districts, parks, neighbourhood food and a long coastline. Attractions are widely spread. Decide whether your stay is urban or beach-focused before choosing a hotel, as the eastern coast is a different journey.

sights.name: Lianhuashan Park
sights.description: A central park with a hilltop view over the civic district. Visit in cooler hours and expect a climb to the viewpoint.

sights.name: Shenzhen Museum
sights.description: City and regional history in museum settings. Check the branch and exhibition location before travelling.

sights.name: Window of the World
sights.description: A theme park of architectural replicas and entertainment. A deliberate family choice, not a substitute for the city's own neighbourhoods.

sights.name: Dameisha
sights.description: A beach excursion east of the centre. Allow for traffic, weather and beach-management rules.

sights.name: Dapeng Fortress
sights.description: A full-day trip to historic lanes in the eastern peninsula area. Pair only with nearby coastal stops, not central-city sightseeing.

foods.name: Cantonese dim sum
foods.description: An easy introduction to southern Chinese dining. Share several small dishes and tea instead of ordering a large fixed meal.

foods.name: Hakka-style dishes
foods.description: Look for stuffed tofu and other Hakka dishes reflecting the region's older communities. Fillings often include meat.

foods.name: Seafood
foods.description: Coastal restaurants offer fish and shellfish prepared in several styles. Confirm weight, cooking charge and total price before ordering.

areas.name: Futian
areas.description: A practical base for central parks, museums and transport; choose your station carefully in this large district.

areas.name: Nanshan / Shekou
areas.description: Good for western waterfront and dining, but farther from eastern beaches and some rail departures.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Bao’an airport, Shenzhen North, Futian and Shenzhen railway stations serve different routes. Cross-border journeys require their own document and timing checks.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use the metro for urban trips and group sights by district. Long east-west journeys can consume much of an afternoon.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Dameisha and Dapeng need dedicated coastal time. Avoid an eastern beach trip immediately before a tightly scheduled train or flight.

routes.name: Urban introduction
routes.description: Pair central parks and a museum on one day. Use another for OCT Loft and a Shenzhen Bay walk.

routes.name: Coastal extension
routes.description: Add Dapeng or Dameisha as a separate outing. Choose according to whether history or beach time matters more to your group.

shenzhen.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

hong-kong.overview: Hong Kong combines compact urban walks with surprisingly spacious coast and country parks. A harbour crossing is part of the experience, but hills and islands deserve their own time. Treat it as a separate travel jurisdiction when planning documents, payment and onward connections.

sights.name: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront
sights.description: An accessible introduction to the harbour skyline. Combine it with nearby museums or a ferry crossing rather than a long checklist.

sights.name: Hong Kong Museum of History
sights.description: Historical context for the city. Check the current exhibitions before choosing how much time to spend.

sights.name: Nan Lian Garden and Chi Lin Nunnery
sights.description: A landscaped garden and Buddhist complex in Kowloon. Keep the visit quiet and follow photography guidance.

sights.name: Lantau and Ngong Ping
sights.description: A full-day trip for mountain scenery and the Tian Tan Buddha area. Transport choice and weather affect the experience.

sights.name: Dragon's Back
sights.description: A separate hiking outing with coastal views. Check weather, route conditions and your group's ability before leaving urban transport behind.

foods.name: Dim sum and tea
foods.description: Choose a few steamed, fried and baked dishes to share. Some restaurants use timed sessions or different ordering systems.

foods.name: Wonton noodles
foods.description: A compact meal of noodles and dumplings, commonly containing shrimp and pork. Useful between neighbourhood walks.

foods.name: Cha chaan teng breakfast
foods.description: Local cafes serve combinations such as eggs, toast, noodles and milk tea. Menus and ordering conventions vary.

areas.name: Tsim Sha Tsui / Jordan
areas.description: Convenient for Kowloon dining and harbour access; room sizes can be compact.

areas.name: Sheung Wan / Central
areas.description: Good for island neighbourhood walks and ferries, with slopes and steps to consider when choosing a hotel.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: The airport, West Kowloon rail terminal and land crossings have distinct onward journeys. Check entry requirements separately from mainland China.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: MTR, buses, trams and ferries suit different journeys. Walking routes on Hong Kong Island may involve steep slopes and stairs.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Lantau, outlying islands and hiking routes each need time for return transport. Avoid planning the last service as your only way back.

routes.name: Harbour and neighbourhoods
routes.description: Pair Kowloon waterfront time with a Star Ferry crossing. Explore Sheung Wan and Central on another day, adding the Peak in suitable weather.

routes.name: A greener day
routes.description: Choose Lantau, an island or a manageable hike. Keep a city alternative if weather makes the outdoor plan unattractive.

hong-kong.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

macao.overview: Macao rewards looking beyond the resort complexes. Its compact historic streets, Chinese temples and Portuguese-influenced buildings tell a layered story, while Taipa and Coloane offer different rhythms. Separate travel-document and payment arrangements from any mainland portion of your trip.

sights.name: A-Ma Temple
sights.description: An active temple complex on the peninsula with courtyards and steps. Respect worshippers and explore the surrounding streets slowly.

sights.name: Mandarin's House
sights.description: A traditional residential complex offering a more intimate architectural visit than the major public squares.

sights.name: Guia Fortress
sights.description: A hilltop historic site with city views. Allow for the ascent and check which interiors are accessible.

sights.name: Macao Museum
sights.description: Historical context beside the Monte Fort area. A useful companion to an old-centre walk rather than a separate cross-city trip.

sights.name: Hac Sa Beach
sights.description: A quieter coastal outing on Coloane. Choose it for a walk and change of atmosphere; check local conditions before entering the water.

foods.name: Portuguese-style egg tarts
foods.description: Small custard pastries with browned tops. Buy a few fresh rather than carrying a large box through a hot day.

foods.name: Minchi
foods.description: A home-style minced-meat dish often served with potatoes, rice and an egg. Recipes vary between restaurants.

foods.name: Almond cookies
foods.description: A crumbly local souvenir snack. Compare ingredients, freshness and packaging if taking a box home.

areas.name: Historic peninsula
areas.description: Best for walking between old-centre sights and small restaurants; some streets are steep or narrow.

areas.name: Taipa / Cotai
areas.description: More resort-style accommodation and larger complexes, with transport needed for peninsula sightseeing.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Check whether you arrive by airport, ferry or land crossing. Terminal choice changes the local transfer, and entry rules differ from mainland China.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk compact historic areas and use buses or taxis between the peninsula, Taipa and Coloane. Large resort interiors can add substantial walking.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: An onward Hong Kong or Zhuhai journey requires a separate transport and border plan. Leave time beyond the scheduled ride itself.

routes.name: Historic day
routes.description: Link the central squares and lanes with the museum or Mandarin's House. Keep a separate block for A-Ma Temple and its surroundings.

routes.name: Island day
routes.description: Explore Taipa Village, then move to Coloane for a slower afternoon and a meal. Avoid rushing back across districts for every snack.

macao.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

nanjing.overview: Nanjing has the scale of a former capital: walls, lakes, museums and wooded hills spread across the city. Choose a historical theme for each day rather than trying to connect all the monuments. Some sites invite reflection, so leave space between them and more recreational stops.

sights.name: Confucius Temple and Qinhuai River
sights.description: A busy riverside district of lanes, food and evening lights. Explore side streets as well as the main visitor route.

sights.name: Xuanwu Lake
sights.description: A broad lakeside park beside the city wall. Choose one shore or island loop for a relaxed outdoor break.

sights.name: Presidential Palace
sights.description: Historic government buildings and gardens in the centre. Allow time for the exhibitions rather than only photographing the entrance.

sights.name: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum
sights.description: A major monument on Purple Mountain with a substantial stair approach. Check reservation and access arrangements before travelling.

sights.name: Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum
sights.description: A wooded historic complex on Purple Mountain. Give the paths and monuments enough walking time; it is not beside every other mountain attraction.

foods.name: Salted duck
foods.description: A signature cold duck dish with a savoury, restrained seasoning. Order a small portion with other dishes.

foods.name: Duck-blood vermicelli soup
foods.description: A local soup commonly containing duck blood curd and offal. Check ingredients before ordering.

foods.name: Tangbao
foods.description: Soup-filled buns served hot. Let them cool and eat carefully to avoid spilling the broth.

areas.name: Xinjiekou
areas.description: Central transport and plentiful dining, useful for a first visit across several districts.

areas.name: Qinhuai / Confucius Temple area
areas.description: Good evening atmosphere, but check noise and vehicle access on pedestrian streets.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Nanjing South and Nanjing railway stations sit in different parts of the city. Lukou airport requires a separate transfer.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro journeys between districts and walking inside large historic sites. Purple Mountain still involves local transfers and substantial walking.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Allow a dedicated day for selected Purple Mountain sites. Do not underestimate the distance between individual entrances.

routes.name: City history
routes.description: Combine a central museum or palace visit with a selected city-wall section. Use another afternoon for Qinhuai streets and dinner.

routes.name: Wooded monuments
routes.description: Choose two compatible Purple Mountain sites for an extra day. Adjust the plan if stairs or hot weather would make it demanding.

nanjing.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

luoyang.overview: Luoyang places ancient capitals and Buddhist art alongside a modern city. Longmen is the anchor for many first visits, but museums and old-city food add context. Peony season changes the atmosphere considerably; outside it, the historical sights remain the main reason to stay.

sights.name: Lijing Gate and old streets
sights.description: An old-city gateway and surrounding lanes suited to an evening food walk. Expect a lively commercial area rather than an untouched town.

sights.name: Sui-Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park
sights.description: Reconstructed monuments and archaeological interpretation. Distinguish modern reconstructions from surviving historic remains while exploring.

sights.name: Guanlin Temple
sights.description: A temple complex associated with Guan Yu, south of the centre. Can fit a southern-city day if travel time allows.

sights.name: National Peony Garden
sights.description: A seasonal flower destination. Choose it for the actual flowering period rather than expecting peonies throughout the year.

sights.name: Luoyang Ancient Tombs Museum
sights.description: A specialised museum for burial history and mural traditions. Check current access and allow a separate transfer from central sights.

foods.name: Luoyang water banquet
foods.description: A succession of soup-based and sauced dishes, traditionally shared. A smaller selection may suit a couple better than a full banquet.

foods.name: Beef or mutton soup
foods.description: A local breakfast tradition, often served with bread. Ask about portions and seasoning before adding chilli.

foods.name: Jiangmian
foods.description: Noodles in a fermented, tangy broth. Try a small bowl if you are unfamiliar with the flavour.

areas.name: Old city / Lijing Gate
areas.description: Useful for evening food and historic streets, with travel needed for Longmen.

areas.name: Luoyang Longmen station area
areas.description: Convenient for fast trains and southern sights; less suited to spontaneous old-city evening walks.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Luoyang Longmen is the main high-speed station for many visitors; central Luoyang station is separate. Check the station name on every ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use the metro where it suits your route and vehicles for outlying sites. Longmen involves outdoor walking after arrival.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Shaolin and Mount Song are separate excursions toward Dengfeng. They should not be squeezed into a full Longmen day.

routes.name: Art and context
routes.description: Give Longmen a generous visit, then keep the evening light. Use another day for Luoyang Museum and the old streets.

routes.name: A seasonal addition
routes.description: Choose a peony garden in bloom or a specialist heritage site. Reserve a separate day if continuing toward Shaolin.

luoyang.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

datong.overview: Datong is an excellent base for Buddhist art and northern architecture. The restored old centre is easy to understand on foot, while the cave temples and suspended monastery lie outside it. A successful visit separates these excursions instead of turning every day into a long road circuit.

sights.name: Nine Dragon Screen
sights.description: A colourful glazed architectural screen in the old city. A compact stop that fits naturally into a central walking route.

sights.name: Shanhua Temple
sights.description: Historic Buddhist halls and sculpture near the southern old city. A useful contrast with Huayan Temple.

sights.name: Datong City Wall
sights.description: A restored wall circuit and viewpoints over the old centre. Choose a section rather than feeling obliged to walk the entire perimeter.

sights.name: Datong Museum
sights.description: Regional archaeology and historical context. Check the location and opening arrangements before adding it to an old-city day.

sights.name: Hengshan
sights.description: A separate mountain outing near Hunyuan. Combine only with nearby plans and allow for stairs, weather and return travel.

foods.name: Knife-cut noodles
foods.description: Thick wheat noodles shaved into the pot and served with varied toppings. A satisfying, inexpensive main meal.

foods.name: Yellow-rice cakes
foods.description: Millet-based cakes, often fried. A rich local snack to share alongside a lighter dish.

foods.name: Shaomai
foods.description: Steamed dumplings with pleated tops and regional fillings. Confirm the filling rather than assuming a southern-style recipe.

areas.name: Inside the old city
areas.description: Convenient for temples and evening walks. Confirm the nearest vehicle access point if arriving with luggage.

areas.name: Datong South area
areas.description: Useful for an early train, but it adds travel to the old-city sights and restaurants.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Datong South railway station is outside the historic centre. Yungang airport also requires a city transfer.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk between central temples and use a vehicle for Yungang. Winter weather can make outdoor waits and long walks uncomfortable.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The Hanging Temple and Hengshan are near Hunyuan, not beside Yungang. Treat the eastern and western excursions as separate days.

routes.name: City and caves
routes.description: Use one day for Huayan, Shanhua and old-city lanes. Give Yungang another generous block with time for the return journey.

routes.name: Hunyuan extension
routes.description: Add a separate Hanging Temple outing, with Hengshan only if your timing and walking ability allow.

datong.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

pingyao.overview: Pingyao is most rewarding after the day-trip crowds thin out. Its lanes, courtyards and merchant history form a compact whole, while the painted sculpture in temples outside town adds another dimension. Stay long enough to see both the busy streets and quieter residential edges.

sights.name: Ancient City Wall
sights.description: An elevated look over the town's roofscape. Choose an accessible section and allow for steps and exposed weather.

sights.name: County Government Office
sights.description: Historic administrative courtyards that help explain how the town functioned. Take time for the sequence of spaces.

sights.name: Confucian Temple
sights.description: A quieter complex associated with education and ritual. A contrast to the commercial streets and banking museums.

sights.name: City God Temple
sights.description: Traditional halls and decorative details within the old city. Follow local worship and photography guidance.

sights.name: Zhenguo Temple
sights.description: A separate excursion outside town for early timber architecture and sculpture. Arrange transport with a clear return plan.

foods.name: Pingyao beef
foods.description: A prepared local beef speciality, often served sliced. Compare portions and packaging if buying it as a gift.

foods.name: Wantuo
foods.description: A local starch-based snack cut into pieces and seasoned. Recipes and hot or cold preparations vary.

foods.name: Shanxi noodles
foods.description: Try a noodle shape you have not eaten before, with vinegar on the side. Sauces commonly contain meat.

areas.name: Old-city courtyard stay
areas.description: Best for atmosphere and evening walks. Ask about heating, bathroom layout and luggage access.

areas.name: Outside the walls
areas.description: Often easier for vehicle access and modern rooms, but less immersive after dinner.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Pingyao Ancient City high-speed station is outside the old town; Pingyao station is different. Confirm the hotel's pickup or final walking directions.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walking is the main way to explore the old centre. Comfortable shoes matter on uneven lanes and courtyard thresholds.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Shuanglin and Zhenguo temples require transfers outside the walls. Choose a realistic sequence rather than assuming they are neighbouring stops.

routes.name: A full old-city day
routes.description: Mix one banking museum, an administrative or temple complex and a wall section. Leave time to wander after dinner.

routes.name: A second day
routes.description: Choose Shuanglin or Zhenguo for sculpture and architecture, then return for a slower meal and any missed courtyards.

pingyao.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

tianjin.overview: Tianjin is a rewarding short city break for river walks, varied architecture and northern snacks. The best route follows neighbourhoods rather than isolated landmarks. Its urban centre and Binhai district are far apart, so decide whether you want a central-city stay or a coastal extension.

sights.name: Italian Style Town
sights.description: A compact district of historic buildings and dining streets. Visit as part of a river walk rather than expecting a large preserved town.

sights.name: Tianjin Eye
sights.description: A river-spanning observation wheel and recognisable landmark. The riverside view can be enjoyable without joining the ride.

sights.name: Tianjin Museum
sights.description: Regional history and art in the cultural-centre district. A useful indoor alternative to a long architectural walk.

sights.name: Jingyuan Garden
sights.description: A historic residence associated with Puyi. A focused visit for travellers interested in the city's modern history.

sights.name: Porcelain House
sights.description: A highly decorated building covered with ceramic elements. Choose it for its unusual appearance and check what the interior visit includes.

foods.name: Jianbing guozi
foods.description: A freshly made savoury breakfast crepe with crisp or fried filling. Ask for chilli according to your preference.

foods.name: Goubuli-style steamed buns
foods.description: A well-known local bun tradition. Compare menus and portions rather than choosing only by a famous sign.

foods.name: Fried dough twists
foods.description: Crunchy mahua pastries sold as snacks and gifts. Check freshness and ingredients before buying a large box.

areas.name: Five Great Avenues area
areas.description: Good for slower architectural walks and cafes, with quieter streets away from major roads.

areas.name: Hai River / central station area
areas.description: Convenient for arrivals and river walks; confirm which station your train uses.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Tianjin station, Tianjin West and Tianjin South are distinct. Binhai airport and Binhai district add separate transfers.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk the central riverfront and use the metro between districts. A bicycle route may be pleasant only where traffic and road conditions suit you.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Binhai attractions are not central-city stops. Reserve a separate day if heading toward the coast.

routes.name: Two easy city days
routes.description: Pair the river and Italian Style Town on arrival. Spend another day around the Five Great Avenues and a museum or historic residence.

routes.name: For a shorter visit
routes.description: Choose architecture or the old commercial streets as your focus, with a relaxed local meal before your train.

tianjin.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

qingdao.overview: Qingdao has several coastal personalities: the old hill streets, leafy villa districts and newer eastern waterfront. Choose a few connected sections rather than attempting the whole shoreline. Sea fog and wind can change the mood quickly, making museums and food useful alternatives.

sights.name: St. Michael's Cathedral
sights.description: A landmark in the old city with a photogenic surrounding square. Respect worship and visitor rules inside.

sights.name: Signal Hill Park
sights.description: A compact hill park with views over tiled roofs and the sea. Expect steps and choose a clear day.

sights.name: May Fourth Square
sights.description: A modern waterfront landmark in the eastern city. Pair it with nearby coastal paths rather than old-town sights on foot.

sights.name: Olympic Sailing Centre
sights.description: Marina views and open waterfront space near the modern centre. Good for a late-afternoon walk when conditions are pleasant.

sights.name: Laoshan
sights.description: A full-day mountain excursion outside the city. Choose one scenic sector and confirm transport and walking requirements.

foods.name: Seafood
foods.description: Clams, fish and other seafood appear on many menus. Confirm whether pricing is per portion or by weight.

foods.name: Qingdao beer
foods.description: A local brewing tradition encountered in restaurants and the museum. Pair tastings with a meal and arrange transport accordingly.

foods.name: Seafood dumplings
foods.description: Dumplings may contain fish, shellfish, pork or mixed fillings. Ask for the exact filling if you have dietary needs.

areas.name: Old town / Qingdao station
areas.description: Best for historic streets and western waterfront walks, though some roads are steep.

areas.name: May Fourth Square area
areas.description: Modern hotels and transport connections, with a different atmosphere from the old city.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Jiaodong airport is well outside the centre. Qingdao and Qingdao North stations serve different journeys.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro links between the old and new centres, then walk short coastal sections. Hills make some inland shortcuts demanding.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Laoshan has multiple scenic areas. Choose one entrance and route rather than treating the mountain as a single quick stop.

routes.name: Old coast and new coast
routes.description: Combine Zhanqiao, old streets and Signal Hill on one day. Use another for Badaguan and a selected eastern waterfront section.

routes.name: A mountain day
routes.description: Add Laoshan only with a full day and suitable weather. Keep the beer museum as an urban alternative.

qingdao.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

jinan.overview: Jinan is a city to explore through water: springs, canals and lakes link its historic core. The small lanes reward walking slowly, while hills and museums offer contrast. Spring flow and weather vary, so enjoy the surrounding gardens as well as the water itself.

sights.name: Black Tiger Spring
sights.description: A spring and waterside walking area near the old centre. Combine it with adjacent canals instead of making a separate vehicle trip.

sights.name: Five Dragon Pool
sights.description: A central park of pools and greenery. A quieter counterpoint to busier landmark spring gardens.

sights.name: Thousand Buddha Mountain
sights.description: A hill excursion south of the centre with temples and city views. Allow time for the ascent and weather.

sights.name: Shandong Museum
sights.description: Provincial history and art in the eastern city. Check exhibition and reservation arrangements before travelling.

sights.name: Furong Street
sights.description: A busy pedestrian food street near the historic core. Browse side lanes too and choose freshly prepared snacks.

foods.name: Youxuan
foods.description: A layered, coiled savoury pastry. Best tried fresh as part of breakfast or a snack stop.

foods.name: Tianmo
foods.description: A savoury millet-based soup despite the sweet-sounding name. Ingredients can include vegetables, peanuts and other additions.

foods.name: Sweet-sour carp
foods.description: A recognisable Shandong banquet dish, best shared. Ask about portion size before ordering alongside other plates.

areas.name: Quancheng Square / old centre
areas.description: Convenient for springs, lanes and dining, with many sights reachable on foot.

areas.name: Eastern museum district
areas.description: Useful for newer hotels and museum visits, but less convenient for repeated old-city walks.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Jinan, Jinan West and Jinan East are separate railway stations. Yaoqiang airport adds a road or public-transport transfer.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk between the central spring areas, using buses, taxis or rail transit for longer journeys where the route fits.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Mount Tai is a separate destination requiring its own transport and mountain plan. Do not attach it casually to a full Jinan day.

routes.name: Follow the water
routes.description: Pair Baotu Spring and Five Dragon Pool with the old lanes. Spend another block around Daming Lake and Qushuiting Street.

routes.name: A different day
routes.description: Choose Thousand Buddha Mountain in suitable weather or Shandong Museum for an indoor history visit.

jinan.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

harbin.overview: Harbin changes dramatically with the seasons. Winter brings ice attractions and short, very cold days; warmer months favour river walks and architecture. Plan the ordinary city first, then add seasonal events only after checking their actual dates and operating conditions.

sights.name: Sun Island
sights.description: A large park area across the river, with different summer and winter experiences. Confirm which section or event you intend to visit.

sights.name: Ice and Snow World
sights.description: A seasonal winter attraction requiring a dedicated outing. Opening dates and conditions vary; do not assume it exists year-round.

sights.name: Lao Daowai
sights.description: Older commercial streets and Chinese-Baroque-style architecture. Explore thoughtfully, distinguishing restored visitor areas from working neighbourhoods.

sights.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Museum
sights.description: Regional collections that add context to an architectural city visit. Check current exhibitions and access.

sights.name: Stalin Park
