sights.description: A riverside promenade near Central Street. A good short walk, adjusted for wind, temperature and river conditions.

foods.name: Guobaorou
foods.description: Crisp pork pieces with a sweet-sour coating. A classic shared plate in northeastern restaurants.

foods.name: Harbin red sausage
foods.description: A local smoked-sausage tradition. Check ingredients, storage and customs restrictions before considering it as a take-home gift.

foods.name: Northeastern dumplings
foods.description: Generous boiled dumplings with meat or vegetable fillings. Order gradually: portions can be substantial.

areas.name: Central Street / Daoli
areas.description: Convenient for architecture, food and river walks. Check heating and room comfort for winter visits.

areas.name: Harbin West station area
areas.description: Practical for an early train, but farther from the historic visitor core.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Taiping airport, Harbin station and Harbin West have different transfers. Allow extra time in winter weather.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use indoor breaks between short walks in cold weather. Metro and taxis help connect districts without long outdoor exposure.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Ice attractions and Sun Island are across the river from much of the old centre. Confirm event access and return transport before setting out.

routes.name: City foundations
routes.description: Pair Central Street, Saint Sophia and a short river walk. Use another day for a museum and Lao Daowai.

routes.name: Seasonal extension
routes.description: Dedicate a separate block to a confirmed winter event, or enjoy Sun Island in warmer weather. Keep the schedule flexible.

harbin.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

shenyang.overview: Shenyang combines Qing-era landmarks with the story of an industrial metropolis. The imperial palace is compact compared with Beijing, leaving time for neighbourhood food and a museum. Outlying tombs and newer districts are best planned as separate blocks rather than a continuous walking route.

sights.name: Marshal Zhang's Mansion
sights.description: A historic residential complex connected with northeastern modern history. Pair it with nearby old-centre sights.

sights.name: Fuling Tomb
sights.description: A Qing imperial tomb in the eastern city. Allow a separate transfer and walking time through the grounds.

sights.name: Liaoning Provincial Museum
sights.description: A major provincial collection in the southern city. Check the exhibition programme and reservation process before travelling.

sights.name: Xita neighbourhood
sights.description: A district associated with Korean food and commercial life. Visit for a meal and street-level exploring rather than a single monument.

sights.name: Industrial Museum of China
sights.description: An introduction to industrial heritage in Tiexi. A different perspective from palaces and imperial tombs.

foods.name: Laobian-style dumplings
foods.description: A local dumpling tradition with varied fillings. Ask about ingredients and order a manageable number of portions.

foods.name: Guobaorou
foods.description: Crisp sweet-sour pork common across the northeast. Share it with vegetables or a lighter soup.

foods.name: Korean-influenced cold noodles
foods.description: A useful option around Xita, with broth and toppings varying by restaurant. Check whether beef or egg is included.

areas.name: Zhongjie / old centre
areas.description: Convenient for the palace, shopping streets and local meals, but some areas stay busy late.

areas.name: Taiyuan Street / Shenyang station
areas.description: Good for transport and hotel choice, with a journey needed to the palace district.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Taoxian airport, Shenyang and Shenyang North railway stations are separate hubs. Check the exact station before leaving the hotel.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Metro journeys connect major districts; group nearby sights on foot. Winter conditions can slow transfers and shorten comfortable outdoor visits.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Fuling and Beiling are different tomb complexes. Pick one if time is limited rather than rushing both between museums.

routes.name: Imperial and modern
routes.description: Pair the palace with Marshal Zhang's Mansion and an old-centre meal. Give Beiling another relaxed block.

routes.name: An extra day
routes.description: Choose the provincial museum or Tiexi industrial history according to your interests, with dinner around Xita.

shenyang.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

dalian.overview: Dalian is a coastal city of plazas, hills and long waterfront roads. It suits a slower visit built around sea views and seafood rather than constant attraction entry. Historic central streets, southern coastal paths and distant resort areas need different transport plans.

sights.name: Laohutan coast
sights.description: A coastal district with viewpoints and visitor attractions. Decide whether you want a waterfront walk or a ticketed attraction before travelling.

sights.name: Bangchuidao
sights.description: A landscaped coastal area with sea views. Check current public access and choose it for an unhurried outdoor visit.

sights.name: Donggang waterfront
sights.description: A modern harbour-side district with broad promenades. Useful for an evening stroll when weather is pleasant.

sights.name: Russian Style Street
sights.description: A short historic-style commercial street near the centre. Pair it with nearby city architecture rather than making it a main-day destination.

sights.name: Jinshitan
sights.description: A full-day coastal excursion northeast of the centre. Choose a particular beach or geological landscape instead of trying to cover the whole area.

foods.name: Seafood
foods.description: Fish, clams and other shellfish dominate many local menus. Confirm portion, weight and cooking charge before ordering.

foods.name: Dalian menzi
foods.description: Pan-fried starch jelly with sauce. A local snack whose dressing often includes sesame and garlic.

foods.name: Seafood dumplings
foods.description: Fish and mixed seafood fillings are common, sometimes with pork. Ask what is inside before ordering a large plate.

areas.name: Zhongshan Square / central station
areas.description: Good for architecture, dining and transport, with limited immediate beach access.

areas.name: Xinghai Square
areas.description: More waterfront space and newer hotels; travel time increases for old-centre sightseeing.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Zhoushuizi airport and Dalian or Dalian North railway stations have different city transfers. Confirm your departure hub.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro or vehicles between coastal districts, then walk a chosen section. Binhai Road is too long to treat as one casual stroll.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Jinshitan and Lushun are separate excursions in different directions. Select one based on your interests and available time.

routes.name: City and coast
routes.description: Spend a day around Zhongshan Square and the central streets. Use another for Xinghai and a manageable Binhai Road section.

routes.name: A longer stay
routes.description: Add Jinshitan for coastal scenery, keeping an indoor alternative if wind or rain changes the plan.

dalian.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

dunhuang.overview: Dunhuang is an oasis base for Buddhist art and desert landscapes. Its famous sights lie in different directions, and the western excursions involve long road days. Put cave reservations first, then arrange dunes and museums around the weather and the light.

sights.name: Mingsha dunes
sights.description: Sand landscapes adjoining the Crescent Lake area. Choose cooler hours and follow marked visitor routes; climbing sand is physically demanding.

sights.name: Yumen Pass
sights.description: A full-day western excursion when linked with suitable nearby heritage stops. Long travel distances matter more than the time at the monument.

sights.name: Yangguan Pass
sights.description: A separate desert heritage outing southwest of town. Allow time for interpretation and avoid expecting a large intact ancient fortress.

sights.name: Yardang National Geopark
sights.description: A full-day desert excursion with wind-shaped formations. Confirm the organised internal route and return transfer.

sights.name: Shazhou market area
sights.description: An evening district for food and souvenir browsing. Compare prices and ask before photographing vendors or craftwork.

foods.name: Yellow noodles
foods.description: A local wheat-noodle tradition, often served with meat or sauce. Ask about the accompanying dish and portion size.

foods.name: Lamb dishes
foods.description: Grilled and stewed lamb are common choices. Order vegetables or lighter sides to balance a meat-heavy meal.

foods.name: Apricot drinks
foods.description: A sweet local refreshment found around visitor areas. Check ingredients and whether it is freshly prepared or bottled.

areas.name: Central Dunhuang / Shazhou
areas.description: Convenient for meals and excursion pickups, with the widest choice for a short stay.

areas.name: Crescent Lake area
areas.description: Atmospheric for dune-focused visits but less convenient for town meals and some departures.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Dunhuang airport and railway station serve the oasis. Liuyuan is a different, much more distant rail stop; check your ticket carefully.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use vehicles between the town, caves and dunes. Save pickup locations offline because sights are spread across open desert areas.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The western passes and Yardang require a dedicated long day. Avoid planning a same-evening flight after an ambitious desert circuit.

routes.name: Art and landscape
routes.description: Build one day around your Mogao reservation. Use another for the museum and dunes in suitable light and temperature.

routes.name: Western extension
routes.description: Add a carefully planned pass-and-desert route only with a spare full day. Keep food, water and return logistics organised.

dunhuang.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

lanzhou.overview: Lanzhou follows the Yellow River between hills, making riverside walking a natural introduction. It is also a useful rail hub, but deserves more than a hurried bowl of noodles. The provincial museum provides context for journeys farther along the Silk Road.

sights.name: Zhongshan Bridge
sights.description: A historic river crossing and landmark beside the northern hills. Pair it with a short waterfront walk.

sights.name: Waterwheel Garden
sights.description: An introduction to traditional river-powered irrigation devices. A compact stop along a wider riverfront day.

sights.name: Five Springs Mountain Park
sights.description: A hillside park with temples and paths south of the centre. Allow for steps and choose a manageable loop.

sights.name: Zhangye Road
sights.description: A central pedestrian shopping area with access to nearby food streets. A useful evening stop rather than a major historic attraction.

sights.name: Bingling Temple
sights.description: A full-day excursion to Buddhist grottoes near the Liujiaxia area. Boat and road arrangements depend on current operations and conditions.

foods.name: Lanzhou beef noodles
foods.description: Freshly pulled noodles in beef broth, often eaten for breakfast. Choose a noodle width and add chilli to taste.

foods.name: Shouzhuayangrou
foods.description: Simply prepared lamb served in pieces. A shared dish best paired with vegetables and bread.

foods.name: Niangpi
foods.description: Cool starch noodles with a tangy dressing. Check toppings and chilli before mixing the bowl.

areas.name: Central riverfront
areas.description: Good for bridge and promenade walks, with access to local food streets.

areas.name: Lanzhou West station area
areas.description: Useful for an early high-speed train but less atmospheric for a short city visit.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Zhongchuan airport is far from the centre. Lanzhou and Lanzhou West railway stations are different; match transfers to your actual ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The city is long and narrow. Combine rail transit or vehicles for east-west travel with walking on selected river sections.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Bingling Temple requires a separate day with checked transport arrangements. Labrang is better planned as an onward regional stay.

routes.name: A river-city pause
routes.description: Visit the provincial museum, then choose a central river walk. Spend another morning around the bridge and White Pagoda Park.

routes.name: With more time
routes.description: Add Bingling Temple if current transfers work, keeping a buffer before onward rail travel.

lanzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

xining.overview: Xining brings together provincial museums, markets and living religious communities at the edge of the plateau. Use the city as a place to slow down before longer regional journeys. Qinghai Lake and monasteries outside the centre need their own transport plans.

sights.name: Qinghai Tibetan Culture Museum
sights.description: A specialised introduction to Tibetan cultural and artistic traditions. Check the exhibition location and allow focused viewing time.

sights.name: Beishan area
sights.description: A northern hillside religious and historic area. Check which sections are open and expect changes in level.

sights.name: People's Park
sights.description: An everyday city park for a gentle walk and a pause between museum visits.

sights.name: Mojia Street area
sights.description: A central food-browsing district. Choose busy vendors preparing food to order and compare menus before sitting down.

sights.name: Qinghai Lake
sights.description: A full-day trip or longer regional stay. Choose a specific shore and route; the lake is too large for a casual add-on.

foods.name: Qinghai yoghurt
foods.description: A local dairy speciality often served plain with sugar separately. Ask about toppings and storage if buying takeaway.

foods.name: Niangpi
foods.description: Cool starch noodles with spicy or tangy seasoning. A common light meal or snack.

foods.name: Hand-grabbed lamb
foods.description: Simply prepared lamb in generous portions. Share it with bread and vegetable dishes.

areas.name: Central Xining
areas.description: Convenient for food and urban sightseeing, with more flexibility than staying beside an outlying attraction.

areas.name: Railway station area
areas.description: Practical for an early departure, but check street noise and access before booking.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Caojiabao airport is outside Xining. Xining railway station is the key hub for many onward rail journeys.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use buses or taxis for spread-out city sights and walk within central areas. Allow a gentle pace rather than packing the arrival day.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Kumbum Monastery and Qinghai Lake are different excursions. Check weather, road conditions and current visitor arrangements before a long regional day.

routes.name: City context
routes.description: Start with a museum and a short neighbourhood walk. Give Kumbum a separate outing with time to observe respectfully.

routes.name: A lake extension
routes.description: Add a planned Qinghai Lake day or overnight route. Do not schedule an ambitious circuit immediately before a fixed departure.

xining.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

urumqi.overview: Ürümqi is a gateway to Xinjiang, but the region is far too large to explore from one hotel. Spend time with museum collections and local food, then choose a specific mountain or onward journey. Confirm current visitor access and transport arrangements for each regional leg.

sights.name: People's Park
sights.description: A central green space for an easy city walk. A useful pause between museums and food stops.

sights.name: Shuimogou Park
sights.description: A park district with water and greenery outside the busiest centre. Allow time for the local transfer.

sights.name: Heavenly Lake
sights.description: A full-day mountain excursion beyond the city. Weather, managed transport and walking determine how much you can see.

sights.name: Southern Pastures
sights.description: A separate countryside outing toward the Tian Shan foothills. Choose a defined destination and return arrangement rather than a vague pasture tour.

sights.name: Tianshan Grand Canyon
sights.description: A full-day scenic excursion with mountain landscapes. Check the specific visitor route, access and transport before departure.

foods.name: Polo
foods.description: Rice cooked with carrots and commonly lamb. A substantial meal; ask about meat and portion size.

foods.name: Lagman
foods.description: Pulled noodles with a vegetable-and-meat topping. Recipes and spice levels vary between restaurants.

foods.name: Nang bread
foods.description: Baked bread in many shapes and textures. Buy small quantities fresh and pair it with a meal rather than treating every type as identical.

areas.name: Central museum / park districts
areas.description: Useful for a city-focused stay and varied transport connections. Confirm accommodation arrangements directly.

areas.name: Railway station area
areas.description: Practical for an early onward journey but requires transfers for many central visitor stops.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Confirm the airport name and terminal on your booking. Ürümqi station and Ürümqi South are separate rail locations.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use the metro where it serves your route and vehicles elsewhere. Keep destination names and hotel details saved in Chinese.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Heavenly Lake, the southern foothills and Turpan are separate journeys. Confirm current access, identification needs and return logistics with providers.

routes.name: A measured city start
routes.description: Give the regional museum a generous visit, then explore a park and local food. Browse the bazaar area on a separate block.

routes.name: Choose one landscape
routes.description: Add Heavenly Lake or a southern mountain excursion. Plan farther Xinjiang destinations as new travel legs with their own accommodation.

urumqi.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

changsha.overview: Changsha combines major archaeological collections with a lively evening food culture. Museum reservations, river geography and summer heat shape a good visit. Cross the river deliberately for Yuelu rather than repeatedly commuting between unrelated stops.

sights.name: Orange Isle
sights.description: A long island park in the Xiang River. Choose a realistic walking section and check local access conditions.

sights.name: Yuelu Mountain
sights.description: Wooded slopes, historic sites and viewpoints west of the river. Give the paths time and expect climbs.

sights.name: Tianxin Pavilion
sights.description: A historic landmark beside a surviving city-wall section. A compact cultural stop near the centre.

sights.name: Taiping Street
sights.description: A busy old-style shopping and snack street. Explore it with nearby lanes and expect crowds at popular hours.

sights.name: Changsha Museum
sights.description: Regional city history in the northern cultural district. An indoor alternative or complement to Hunan Museum.

foods.name: Stinky tofu
foods.description: Fermented tofu served freshly fried with sauce. Try a small portion first; toppings can be spicy.

foods.name: Rice noodles
foods.description: A local breakfast staple with varied meat and vegetable toppings. Specify chilli preferences before the bowl is dressed.

foods.name: Steamed fish head with chopped chilli
foods.description: A shared Hunan dish with a strong chilli flavour. Check fish size and price before ordering.

areas.name: Wuyi Square area
areas.description: Convenient for food and nightlife, but request a quiet room if sensitive to late noise.

areas.name: Yuelu / university side
areas.description: Good for western-bank sights and a slower stay, with river crossings for central nightlife.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Huanghua airport and Changsha South high-speed station connect through different transport options. Changsha station is a separate central hub.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro journeys to cross between districts, then walk local clusters. Riverfront distances are longer than they appear on a simple map.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Shaoshan is a separate excursion. Do not add it after a full museum-and-mountain day.

routes.name: Collections and food
routes.description: Build a day around Hunan Museum and keep the evening for a relaxed food walk. Avoid rushing multiple museum visits together.

routes.name: Across the river
routes.description: Combine Yuelu Academy with a manageable mountain route. Give Orange Isle its own time if walking the longer sections.

changsha.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

wuhan.overview: Wuhan is a city of rivers and separate urban centres. Hankou streets, Wuchang landmarks and East Lake each deserve a coherent block of time. Breakfast is an essential part of the visit, while repeated cross-river transfers can quietly consume the day.

sights.name: Guiyuan Temple
sights.description: An active Buddhist complex in Hanyang. Allow a quiet visit and respect photography guidance.

sights.name: Hankou riverfront
sights.description: Broad riverside public space and historic commercial streets nearby. Choose a section rather than walking the whole embankment.

sights.name: Jianghan Road
sights.description: A pedestrian shopping street with historic buildings. Pair it with nearby Hankou lanes and a meal.

sights.name: Qingchuan Pavilion
sights.description: A historic riverside site with views toward the Yangtze. A useful Hanyang stop rather than a cross-city detour.

sights.name: Tanhualin
sights.description: A compact district of old streets, cafes and cultural spaces in Wuchang. Explore at street level between larger landmarks.

foods.name: Hot dry noodles
foods.description: Noodles coated in sesame-based sauce, commonly eaten for breakfast. Mix thoroughly and ask about chilli and toppings.

foods.name: Doupi
foods.description: A layered breakfast dish with glutinous rice and savoury fillings. Meat and egg are common ingredients.

foods.name: Lotus-root soup
foods.description: A regional comfort dish, often simmered with pork ribs. Confirm the broth if seeking a vegetarian meal.

areas.name: Jianghan Road / Hankou
areas.description: Good for breakfast, historic streets and evening river walks.

areas.name: Wuchang / near East Lake
areas.description: Useful for museums and lake time, with longer journeys to Hankou dining districts.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Wuhan, Hankou and Wuchang railway stations are different. Tianhe airport is another transfer; always check the exact arrival and departure hub.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro crossings between major districts. Walk within one riverbank or lake sector instead of zigzagging across the city.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: East Lake is extensive. Select a specific greenway or visitor area and arrange the return route before a long walk.

routes.name: Two sides of Wuhan
routes.description: Use one day for the museum and a selected East Lake section. Spend another around Yellow Crane Tower and Wuchang streets.

routes.name: A food-focused extension
routes.description: Start with breakfast in Hankou, then explore Jianghan Road and the riverfront without another cross-river transfer.

wuhan.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

zhengzhou.overview: Zhengzhou is a practical transport hub with important archaeological context of its own. Give the provincial museum time before heading toward the more famous sights around Dengfeng or Luoyang. Those places need dedicated travel blocks rather than being treated as suburbs.

sights.name: Shang Dynasty city-wall remains
sights.description: Earthwork remains that reveal the city's much older past. Best appreciated with historical context rather than as a grand intact wall.

sights.name: Zhengzhou Museum
sights.description: Local history and archaeological collections. Check the branch and exhibitions before travelling across the city.

sights.name: Yellow River Scenic Area
sights.description: A separate outing north of the centre for river landscapes and monuments. Allow for extensive grounds and local transfers.

sights.name: Songyang Academy
sights.description: A full-day Dengfeng excursion when paired with a nearby compatible stop. A historic academy at the foot of Mount Song.

sights.name: Mount Song
sights.description: A dedicated mountain day around Dengfeng. Choose a particular route and avoid assuming all entrances are beside Shaolin.

foods.name: Huimian
foods.description: Broad noodles in a rich broth, commonly with lamb. A filling one-bowl introduction to Henan food.

foods.name: Hulatang
foods.description: A peppery breakfast soup with varied ingredients. Ask about meat and spice before ordering.

foods.name: Guotie
foods.description: Pan-fried dumplings with crisp bases. Fillings vary; order a small plate alongside soup or vegetables.

areas.name: Erqi / central station
areas.description: Convenient for older commercial streets and local food, but traffic can be busy.

areas.name: Zhengdong / East station
areas.description: Practical for high-speed rail and newer hotels, with transfers to older central sights.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Xinzheng airport, Zhengzhou station and Zhengzhou East serve different arrivals. Match your hotel location to the actual rail ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The metro helps connect urban districts. Museum locations and older archaeological remains are not all in the same walking area.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Shaolin and Mount Song lie near Dengfeng. Arrange a dedicated excursion or overnight stay with a clear return plan.

routes.name: City context
routes.description: Visit Henan Museum, then choose a central archaeological or neighbourhood walk. Keep time for a noodle meal.

routes.name: Dengfeng day
routes.description: Choose Shaolin plus a realistic nearby stop, or a mountain route. Avoid combining a strenuous climb with a rushed evening train.

zhengzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

fuzhou.overview: Fuzhou offers a slower Fujian city stay of lanes, banyan shade, temples and riverfront neighbourhoods. Its old centre and the districts across the Min River have different atmospheres. The coast, mountains and inland tea country should be planned as separate journeys.

sights.name: Fujian Museum
sights.description: Provincial collections near the West Lake area. A useful introduction before exploring other parts of Fujian.

sights.name: Gushan
sights.description: A hill-and-temple excursion east of the centre. Expect steps and leave time for the return journey.

sights.name: Xichan Temple
sights.description: An active Buddhist temple with courtyards and architectural details. Keep the visit respectful and unhurried.

sights.name: Shangxiahang
sights.description: A restored historic commercial district with lanes and waterside spaces. Pair it with nearby riverfront exploring.

sights.name: Yu Mountain
sights.description: A central hill with historic sites and shaded paths. A manageable contrast to the busy old commercial streets.

foods.name: Fuzhou fish balls
foods.description: Fish-paste balls often enclosing a pork filling. Ask about the centre rather than assuming they contain only fish.

foods.name: Rouyan
foods.description: Meat-filled dumplings with an unusual thin wrapper made using pork. They are not a vegetarian wonton alternative.

foods.name: Dingbianhu
foods.description: A rice-batter soup with varied savoury additions. A good breakfast choice; seafood ingredients may be present.

areas.name: Dongjiekou / old centre
areas.description: Convenient for lanes, food and central sightseeing, with strong transport access.

areas.name: Yantai Hill / Cangshan
areas.description: Good for atmospheric streets and cafes, with river crossings for northern-city attractions.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Changle airport is outside the centre. Fuzhou and Fuzhou South railway stations are separate; check the station on your ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use metro journeys between districts and walk selected historic neighbourhoods. Shaded breaks help in hot, humid weather.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Mount Wuyi and the tulou are separate regional destinations. Do not treat them as quick additions to a city day.

routes.name: Historic neighbourhoods
routes.description: Pair Three Lanes and Seven Alleys with West Lake or the museum. Spend another day around Shangxiahang and Yantai Hill.

routes.name: A greener extension
routes.description: Choose Gushan for a dedicated outdoor block, keeping a temple or museum alternative for poor weather.

fuzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

quanzhou.overview: Quanzhou is a city of maritime connections and living religious traditions. Temples, a mosque, old trading streets and everyday food sit close together in the historic core. Take time to understand the sites instead of reducing them to a quick photo circuit.

sights.name: Tianhou Temple
sights.description: A temple associated with the sea goddess Mazu and maritime life. Observe worship respectfully and look for the architectural details.

sights.name: Quanzhou Maritime Museum
sights.description: Context for the city's trading networks and religious diversity. A strong complement to walking the historic centre.

sights.name: Qingyuan Mountain
sights.description: A hill excursion with the famous Laozi stone figure and walking routes. Give it a separate half-day or longer.

sights.name: Luoyang Bridge
sights.description: A historic stone bridge north of the centre. A separate transfer makes it better suited to an unhurried extra day.

sights.name: Guanyue Temple
sights.description: A busy active temple near the historic core. Visit with consideration for worshippers and avoid blocking ritual spaces.

foods.name: Mianxianhu
foods.description: A fine-noodle soup with selectable additions. Meat, seafood and offal toppings vary between stalls.

foods.name: Quanzhou zongzi
foods.description: Glutinous-rice parcels commonly filled with meat and other savoury ingredients. A substantial snack rather than a light bite.

foods.name: Ginger duck
foods.description: Duck cooked with plenty of ginger, usually shared. Check the portion size before ordering for a small group.

areas.name: West Street / old centre
areas.description: Best for early and evening walks, but lanes may limit vehicle access and rooms can be noisy.

areas.name: Fengze
areas.description: More modern hotels and convenient city transfers, with a journey needed for historic-core wandering.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Jinjiang airport is outside the old centre. Quanzhou railway stations serve different routes, so use the exact name on your ticket.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Walk the historic core and use buses or taxis for outlying sights. Build breaks into hot-weather temple and street visits.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Qingyuan Mountain, Luoyang Bridge and coastal villages are separate outings. Avoid adding all of them to a full old-city day.

routes.name: Maritime city
routes.description: Pair Kaiyuan and West Street, then use another block for Qingjing Mosque, nearby temples and local food.

routes.name: Beyond the lanes
routes.description: Choose the Maritime Museum plus a short central walk, or a separate Qingyuan Mountain outing.

quanzhou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

sanya.overview: Sanya is a collection of bays with different hotel styles and transfer distances. Choose your base around how you want to spend most days: accessible city dining, resort time or a quieter beach setting. A good beach holiday leaves room for weather rather than filling every day with attractions.

sights.name: Sanya Bay
sights.description: A long urban coastline suited to evening walks. Choose a section near your base instead of trying to cover the whole bay.

sights.name: Haitang Bay
sights.description: A resort-focused coast farther from the urban centre. Good for hotel time; do not assume every stretch is suitable for swimming.

sights.name: Wuzhizhou Island
sights.description: A separate island day trip with boat and activity arrangements. Weather can affect access and the experience.

sights.name: Luhuitou
sights.description: A hilltop park with views over the city and bays. Choose cooler hours and allow for the uphill approach.

sights.name: Tianya Haijiao
sights.description: A coastal landmark park west of the city. Pair it only with nearby plans rather than a cross-city beach circuit.

foods.name: Hainan chicken
foods.description: Simply prepared chicken served with rice or side dishes. Sauces vary and can be served separately.

foods.name: Coconut chicken hotpot
foods.description: A shared chicken broth with coconut flavour. Follow the restaurant's cooking instructions before eating ingredients.

foods.name: Qingbuliang
foods.description: A sweet dessert with assorted beans, fruit and other toppings, often in coconut milk. Check the ingredients before ordering.

areas.name: Dadonghai / urban Sanya
areas.description: Convenient for restaurants and shorter city transfers, with a busier beach atmosphere.

areas.name: Yalong Bay / Haitang Bay
areas.description: Resort-oriented stays with more time spent at the hotel. Check the actual beach conditions and transfer distances.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Phoenix airport and Sanya railway station require different transfers to each bay. Confirm the hotel's district before judging travel time.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use vehicles between bays and walk locally. Moving repeatedly between resort areas can consume much of a day.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Island trips and western coastal attractions need separate planning. Follow local swimming flags and weather guidance rather than assuming all beaches are equivalent.

routes.name: A relaxed first stay
routes.description: Keep the arrival day at your chosen bay. Add Luhuitou or a city meal on another day without changing beaches repeatedly.

routes.name: Choose one outing
routes.description: Select Nanshan, Tianya Haijiao or an island trip according to your interests, and retain a weather-flexible resort day.

sanya.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

haikou.overview: Haikou is an urban introduction to Hainan, with arcaded streets, neighbourhood breakfast and provincial history. It offers a different experience from Sanya's resort bays. Use it for cultural walks and selected coastal or volcanic excursions rather than expecting every hotel to be a beach retreat.

sights.name: Temple of Five Lords
sights.description: A historic complex linked with officials exiled to Hainan. A compact cultural visit near other southern-city sites.

sights.name: Qiongtai Academy
sights.description: A traditional academy in the older Qiongshan area. Pair it with nearby heritage stops rather than a separate cross-city journey.

sights.name: Haikou volcanic landscape
sights.description: A full-day or generous half-day excursion southwest of the city. Expect outdoor walking and choose a defined visitor route.

sights.name: Wanlu Park
sights.description: A large urban green space near the coast. Useful for a gentle walk in cooler hours.

sights.name: Hai Rui's Tomb
sights.description: A historic memorial site associated with the Ming official. A focused stop for visitors interested in Hainan's cultural history.

foods.name: Hainan rice noodles
foods.description: Local rice noodles with savoury toppings and dressing. Seafood and meat additions vary by shop.

foods.name: Laoba tea
foods.description: An everyday tea-house tradition with small snacks and bakery items. Sit for a while rather than treating it as takeaway coffee.

foods.name: Wenchang chicken
foods.description: A Hainan speciality often served simply with dipping sauces. Ask about portion size and accompaniments.

areas.name: Qilou / old centre
areas.description: Good for arcaded streets and local food, though older buildings may have varied room standards.

areas.name: Wanlu Park / coastal city area
areas.description: More contemporary hotels and open space, with transfers needed for old-town meals.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Meilan airport connects with island rail services. Haikou East and Haikou station are different; the latter is farther west.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use walking within the old streets and buses or taxis for spread-out sights. Heat and rain make midday breaks useful.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: The volcanic area and mangrove excursions need dedicated transfers. Sanya is a separate stay or rail journey rather than an urban side trip.

routes.name: City introduction
routes.description: Explore Qilou streets and a tea house, then use another block for Hainan Museum and the Qiongshan heritage area.

routes.name: Outdoor extension
routes.description: Choose the volcanic landscape or a coastal park day according to weather. Keep the evening free for local food.

haikou.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

wuyishan.overview: Wuyishan is about the relationship between river, cliffs and tea. Base yourself for the scenic area rather than assuming the city centre is the attraction. Choose a few complementary routes and leave space for a tea session instead of attempting every climb.

sights.name: Dahongpao tea trail
sights.description: A walking area associated with the famous rock-tea tradition. Use it to understand the landscape as well as taste the tea.

sights.name: Wuyi Palace
sights.description: A cultural area near the river and scenic routes. A gentler stop to balance a day with a steep climb.

sights.name: Water Curtain Cave area
sights.description: A separate scenic walking sector with cliffs and tea-country surroundings. Check route conditions and allow time for the return connection.

sights.name: Roaring Tiger Rock
sights.description: A steep scenic route for walkers comfortable with stairs. Choose it as an alternative climb rather than stacking it after Tianyou.

sights.name: Yixiantian
sights.description: A narrow rock passage in the scenic area. Consider crowding, confined space and slippery steps before including it.

foods.name: Wuyi rock tea
foods.description: Locally associated oolong teas vary widely in taste and price. Agree on tasting and purchase terms before a long session.

foods.name: Smoked goose
foods.description: A regional speciality with a strong flavour, often served with chilli. Ask about spice level before ordering.

foods.name: Bamboo-shoot dishes
foods.description: Seasonal shoots appear in local cooking, often with meat. Confirm the preparation if you prefer a lighter or meat-free dish.

areas.name: Sangu resort area
areas.description: A practical visitor base with restaurants and access toward the scenic entrances.

areas.name: Wuyishan urban centre
areas.description: Useful for city services, but adds transfers if every day is focused on the scenic area.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Check the exact railway station, such as Nanping City or Wuyishan North, and arrange the onward transfer to your base.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: The scenic area combines managed transport and walking. Separate entrances, climbs and raft departure points need a planned sequence.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Rafting is weather- and operation-dependent. Keep a land-based alternative and confirm the correct departure point and time.

routes.name: River and cliffs
routes.description: Give Tianyou a dedicated walking block. Put the Nine Bend River on a separately confirmed slot rather than rushing between the two.

routes.name: Tea-country day
routes.description: Choose one tea-country walk and an unhurried tasting. Add another climb only if weather and energy make it worthwhile.

wuyishan.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.

jingdezhen.overview: Jingdezhen is most rewarding when you follow the making of porcelain, not just the finished objects. Museums give context; workshops and markets reveal contemporary practice. Leave room in the itinerary for browsing and conversations, and plan packing before buying fragile pieces.

sights.name: China Ceramics Museum
sights.description: A broad introduction to ceramic history and technique. Useful before shopping, so shapes and glazes have more meaning.

sights.name: Ancient Kiln Folk Customs Museum
sights.description: Kiln structures and craft interpretation in a dedicated visitor setting. Check which demonstrations are actually scheduled.

sights.name: Sanbao village
sights.description: A spread-out ceramics and creative district outside the centre. Plan local transfers and confirm workshop visits in advance.

sights.name: Yaoli
sights.description: A full-day village excursion for historic streets and a greener landscape. It requires a separate road journey from central Jingdezhen.

sights.name: Fuliang Ancient County Office
sights.description: A heritage outing north of the city that offers context beyond ceramics. Combine only with geographically compatible stops.

foods.name: Jiaozi ba
foods.description: A local snack with a rice-based wrapper and savoury fillings. Ask about meat and chilli before choosing a portion.

foods.name: Lengfen
foods.description: Cool starch noodles with seasoning. A simple snack whose chilli level and toppings vary.

foods.name: Jiangxi-style home cooking
foods.description: Local meals often feature rice, vegetables and strongly seasoned meat or fish. Request mild preparation early if needed.

areas.name: Imperial kiln / central city
areas.description: Good for museum access and older streets, with a range of small hotels.

areas.name: Taoxichuan / creative districts
areas.description: Useful for contemporary ceramics and evening browsing. Check actual market dates rather than assuming stalls operate every night.

transport.name: Arriving
transport.description: Jingdezhen North station and Luojia airport serve arrivals outside the main museum streets. Confirm your accommodation's exact district.

transport.name: Getting around
transport.description: Use vehicles between museum and workshop districts, then walk locally. Sanbao is spread out and is not one compact indoor market.

transport.name: Beyond the centre
transport.description: Yaoli needs its own excursion day. For workshop visits, confirm language, duration, firing and shipping arrangements before paying.

routes.name: From history to making
routes.description: Visit the ceramics museum before the imperial kiln area. Use another day for a confirmed workshop and Taoxichuan browsing.

routes.name: A third day
routes.description: Choose Sanbao for contemporary studios or Yaoli for village scenery. Keep time to inspect, pack and document any purchases.

jingdezhen.status: Editorial planning notes; confirm current access, reservations and transport before booking.
